start_here: Say to your AI: "Offer to connect a service when words I wrote link to one I have not connected", with {"text":"Copy the roadmap from https://www.notion.so/launch","tools":[{"id":"tool:notion","invoke":{"provider":"notion","connects":{"domain":"notion.so"}}}]}. It runs tool:suggest-connections-from-links and answers {"hosts":["notion.so"],"suggestions":[{"provider":"notion","host":"notion.so","reason":"Your work links to notion.so"}]}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Offer to connect a service when words I wrote link to one I have not connected", and give it text; tools.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:suggest-connections-from-links and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give text (the words to read links from, with or without https://) and tools (the connection rows, each { id, invoke: { provider, connects: { domain } } }), and connected (providers already connected, left out of the answer).
